suites.title: Property-based fuzzing
suites.blurb: fast-check generators throw arbitrary strings, hosts and schemes at the allowlist; no input may resolve to an unallowlisted navigation.

suites.title: Normalization edge cases
suites.blurb: trailing slashes, uppercase/mixed-case hosts, explicit default ports, trailing-dot hosts, suffix grafts.

suites.title: Percent-encoding edge cases
suites.blurb: percent-encoded hosts, userinfo smuggling, encoded path/query, homoglyph hosts.

suites.title: Redirect audit records
suites.blurb: audit rows keep origin-only candidates and path-only targets — never full URLs, query strings or fragments.

suites.title: Checkout success target resolution
suites.blurb: allowlisted spoke origins drive the primary CTA / auto-redirect; anything else falls back to a safe Hub target.
